[P1] Avoid factorial rechecks of non-context parameters

With this rule enabled, ordinary helpers such as `function f1(xs) { return xs.map(x => x); }` trigger factorial work. `isChildContextFunction()` scans every candidate call, including the call on the parameter currently being checked. Every negative check therefore reaches an unfinished check and remains uncached here, causing sibling checks to explore the remaining parameters in every permutation. Twelve such helpers entail over a billion full context checks, effectively hanging editor linting and CI despite containing no durable operations. Resolve which calls actually pass the function before recursively checking their receivers, or use a bounded fixed-point traversal. Add a regression covering multiple unrelated array-map helpers.
